title: Predictability of El Niño from Delayed Observations
summary: Using monthly Niño-3.4 anomalies through July 2026, we investigate how much predictive information is contained in delayed observations of the index. Ridge regression identifies informative delays, while multilayer perceptron and sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) models test whether nonlinear complexity provides additional direct forecast skill; gated recurrent unit (GRU) and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks provide a complementary test in which the temporal representation is learned internally.
